scenes.title: Monastery Chronicle
scenes.summary: Eight hundred years ago, inside the quiet scriptorium of Sineozersk monastery, monk Konstantin is busy copying an ancient book.

scenes.title: Attack on the Monastery
scenes.summary: Suddenly, alarms echo through the monastery courtyard as enemy invaders break through the gates.

scenes.title: The Monastery Wall
scenes.summary: In the present day, a university history professor lectures his students before an ancient stone wall.

scenes.title: Leak from the Office
scenes.summary: Local television broadcasts shocking leaked footage recorded by a hidden camera inside the mayor's office.

scenes.title: Comfort in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In their communal apartment, Nina is devastated and deeply embarrassed by the recent online scandal.

scenes.title: Steven Snegov
scenes.summary: In this flashback scene, Nina sends Samson off on a lucrative business journey.

scenes.title: The Frontera Car
scenes.summary: Right after that, Samson arrives at a highway checkpoint driving an imported foreign SUV.

scenes.title: Meeting at the Airport
scenes.summary: Meanwhile, Samson learns that his connecting flight will be delayed for three hours.

scenes.title: Beginner's Luck
scenes.summary: Back in Sineozersk, Samson tries his hand at roulette inside the airport casino.

scenes.title: The Casino Winnings
scenes.summary: At an underground gambling den in Sineozersk, Ivan Samsonov and Rozhok watch the roulette wheel turn.

scenes.title: Down to Zero
scenes.summary: The final roulette spin lands on black, leaving Samsonov and Rozhok completely broke.

scenes.title: After the Loss
scenes.summary: Out on the cold street, the full magnitude of Samsonov's disaster sets in.

scenes.title: Confession to Nina
scenes.summary: Back in the communal apartment, Ivan Samsonov finally admits the bitter truth to his wife Nina.

scenes.title: The Plan and the Money
scenes.summary: At the mayor's office, acting mayor Pavel Osipenko goes over the corrupt investment scheme with his associate Denis.

scenes.title: A Call to the Governor
scenes.summary: Still under house arrest, Arkady calls regional governor Viktor Stepanovich to reveal that the tech cluster investment is a secret law enforcement sting.

scenes.title: Handing Over the Money
scenes.summary: At an isolated warehouse on the edge of town, acting mayor Pavel Osipenko meets with investor Panov for the covert handover of millions in cash.

scenes.title: Raid at the Warehouse
scenes.summary: Armed special forces burst into the abandoned warehouse just as Pavel and his partners finish packing the bribe money into vehicles.

scenes.title: Special Operation at the Warehouse
scenes.summary: At an abandoned warehouse outside Sineozersk, FSB Major Lavrov and his tactical team launch a surprise raid.

scenes.title: Defending the Monastery
scenes.summary: Near the ancient monastery wall, Ivan Samsonov arrives to persuade Marina to leave the protest safely.

scenes.title: The Builders' Retreat
scenes.summary: At the monastery wall, the tense standoff abruptly changes as the heavy demolition machinery turns around.

scenes.title: Memory of Father
scenes.summary: After the workers retreat from the monastery grounds, Father Grigory approaches Marina in quiet reflection.

scenes.title: Historical Heritage
scenes.summary: Near the ancient monastery, a legal consultant discusses the legal ramifications of recent protests with Christian.

scenes.title: Detention by the Wall
scenes.summary: Near the contested monastery wall, security forces detain the young protesters after a scuffle.

scenes.title: Interrogation by the Khan
scenes.summary: At the historical reenactment camp near the monastery, reenactors stage an interrogation scene in medieval costume.

scenes.title: Caviar with the Governor
scenes.summary: At Governor Viktor Stepanovich's residence, Arkady nurses his injured finger after the monastery scuffle.

scenes.title: Call from Moscow
scenes.summary: Following the high-profile arrests in Sineozersk, regional governor Viktor Stepanovich receives a confidential phone call from Moscow.

scenes.title: Minister of Fisheries
scenes.summary: Ecstatic after his phone call from Moscow, Governor Viktor Stepanovich hurries to share the grand news with his loyal aide Stepanych.

scenes.title: All for the Minister Post
scenes.summary: At the governor's residence, Arkady Borisovich watches with amazement as millions of rubles are loaded into heavy bags.

scenes.title: Fishing at the Lake
scenes.summary: Claiming fatigue and the need for absolute secrecy, Governor Viktor Stepanovich drives Arkady out to a frozen lake for an impromptu winter fishing trip.

scenes.title: Stepanovich's Betrayal
scenes.summary: Viktor Stepanovich informs Arkady that he cannot make him governor or mayor and refuses to let him go.

scenes.title: At the Ice Hole
scenes.summary: Viktor Stepanovich orders his thugs to strip Arkady and drown him in an ice hole despite his desperate pleas.

scenes.title: Rescued from the Ice
scenes.summary: FSB officers rescue Arkady from freezing water and arrest Viktor Stepanovich on the spot.

scenes.title: The Deal with the FSB
scenes.summary: Arkady proposes an elaborate sting operation against the governor in exchange for his freedom, but Marina takes charge of the negotiations.

scenes.title: Sitting Before the Journey
scenes.summary: The Samsonov family packs their bags and prepares for the journey to Siberia.

scenes.title: Pasha's Conscience
scenes.summary: Samsonov confronts Pasha over his ruthless violence and asks if he has a conscience.

scenes.title: A Good Boss
scenes.summary: The characters reflect on morality, greed, and what makes a truly good leader.

scenes.title: Meeting with the Minister
scenes.summary: Arkady and the team celebrate their successful meeting with the Minister of Culture.
